The rough, sandpaper-like plaque on your sun-exposed hand is highly suggestive of a sun-induced dermatosis; could you tell me if the lesion is distinctly brown, gray, or has a "stuck-on" appearance, and do you see fine white lines or a central white patch (Moiré pattern) on the dermoscopy images I requested? DIAGNOSIS READY: Leukoplakia of the hand (often a variant of actinic keratosis or cutaneous horn).
